postconditions.expression: all(0 <= n_0, n_1, n_2 <= 100 and n_0 + n_1 + n_2 > 0 for n_0, n_1, n_2 in inputs)
postconditions.description: The input values n_0, n_1, n_2 are non-negative integers, and their sum is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n_0 + n_1 + n_2 for n_0, n_1, n_2, s in zip(inputs, outputs))
postconditions.description: The length of the output string s is the sum of the input values n_0, n_1, n_2.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - 1) if s[i:i+2] == '11') == n_1 for s in outputs)
postconditions.description: The output string s contains n_1 pairs of '11' characters.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - 1) if s[i:i+2] == '00') == n_0 for s in outputs)
postconditions.description: The output string s contains n_0 pairs of '00' characters.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - 1) if s[i:i+2] == '10') == n_2 or sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - 1) if s[i:i+2] == '01') == n_2 for s in outputs)
postconditions.description: The output string s contains n_2 pairs of '10' or '01' characters.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in s) for s in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string s is either '0' or '1'.
